claims.text: The FDA boxed warning says opioids such as nalbuphine with alcohol may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of opioids with benzodiazepines or other central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including alcohol, may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

claims.text: The French label says alcohol increases nalbuphine's sedative effect.
claims.quote: Majoration par l'alcool de l'effet sédatif de la nalbuphine.
claims.quoteEnglish: Alcohol increases the sedative effect of nalbuphine.

headline.text: The FDA boxed warning links nalbuphine with alcohol to profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death.

reported.text: The French label also describes increased sedation from alcohol with nalbuphine.
